method: xpts.json has no selected_by_percent field, so ownership is sourced from web (FFFix GW1 ownership/captaincy stats, OneFPL template team, FFScout ownership watch). EO = own% + captain%.
data_quality_warnings: xpts.json contains NO entry for B.Fernandes - Gemini's captain pick is xPts-driven, so it could not even consider the squad's current captain.
xpts.json top xPts is Mendy (HUL, DEF, 4.0m) at 16.42. A 4.0m defender projecting 16.4 pts is a model artifact, not a real signal - defender realistic ceiling is ~12-15 and modal outcome is 2-6.
Cache team labels look corrupted vs real 26/27 (Semenyo->MCI, Rogers->CHE, Munoz->LIV as MID). Player-level EO still usable; team-level FDR is not trustworthy.

template_captain.note: Was 50%+ captained in GW1 with 3x Bruno's backing. Away at Palace softens the share slightly but he remains top of most GW2 captaincy metrics. Squad does NOT own him.

captain_shield.why: DO NOT FADE. Home vs newly-promoted Ipswich. Tops the GW2 points projection (6.7) and is tied-top on model overall score; ranked 1st among mids for home FPL points (235) and assists (12) last season. Penalties + set pieces = highest floor of any GW2 captain option. Captaincy share is rising off 17.2% in GW1 toward high-20s. This is the correct armband for a squad that does not own Haaland - it is the closest-to-template captain actually available.
The genuine template captain, but UNOWNED by this squad. Cannot be shielded via armband this week - only via a transfer. Flag as the single largest standing rank risk, not as a GW2 captain decision.

differentials.why: Leeds GW1 match-winner via direct free-kick. On set pieces with defensive-contribution points upside and a soft Leeds fixture run. Best pure rank-chasing asset at sub-2% EO. Squad does not own.

11-pt haul in GW1 (goal + max bonus) at 6.5m. Safer high-upside differential than Stach if his form is genuinely back. Note: xpts.json rates him only 1.45 - treat that projection as unreliable given the cache issues.

ALREADY OWNED and already in the starting XI. Creativity plus a partial penalty role. A free differential the squad is holding - Gemini benches him for Mendy, which trades a real sub-5% differential for a projection artifact.

rank_risks.detail: 69.3% owned, ~42% captained => ~111 EO. Every Haaland return is effectively doubled against this squad. This is the structural gap, and it is a transfer problem, not a captain problem.

Mendy is a 4.0m defender at effectively 0% EO, and is not even in the squad - he requires the transfer. Captaining him fades an ~80 EO Bruno AND an ~111 EO Haaland simultaneously with zero supporting real-world signal. The 16.42 xPts is a data artifact. Backtest lesson applies directly: never go differential captain without a strong signal. REJECT.
Swaps a genuine sub-5% differential with a penalty role for an unproven 4.0m defender.
Bench player, low EO. Replacing him is fine - the objection is to the specific replacement, not the transfer.

verdict.recommendation: KEEP B.Fernandes (C). He is ~80 EO with the highest floor of any captain this squad can actually pick, and he tops the GW2 projections. Mendy is a ~0 EO blowup risk driven by a corrupted xPts row - do not let sim-lab or the-gaffer promote it.
